notes.title: Unhinged 2 Demo on Steam! Yeah!
notes.content:
Hello folks, finally got a demo of Unhinged 2 out on Steam. 
It's pretty similar to the demo from 2022, but all noncommercial assets were replaced, the city has much more detail to it, mistakes here and there were fixed, it's no longer one big single level (should run a bit smoother), some addition bits and bobs such as chainsaw death animation for enemies, and a few other things I forgot.

That being said, I do want to make an extended demo this Halloween! Adding just a bit more gameplay and options, so stay tuned!
